research_question: Can a prior-only adaptive router decide whether high cross-sectional 24-hour crypto dispersion should continue or reverse, while preserving a complete day-trading scenario and one global position?

sources: cross-sectional momentum and short-term reversal in cryptocurrencies
dispersion trading and winner-loser portfolio research
online expert selection using matured shadow outcomes
reused: the largest absolute residual 24-hour winner or loser defines the focal market
continuation and reversal are distinct mutually exclusive policies
their own fully matured prior outcomes determine which policy is active
entry waits for a subsequent completed one-hour confirmation

scenario.context: at each completed 00:00 UTC boundary, rank the four completed 24-hour returns and require high cross-sectional dispersion

state.DAILY_DISPERSION_MOMENTUM: trade in the direction of the unique largest absolute residual market
state.DAILY_DISPERSION_REVERSAL: trade opposite the unique largest absolute residual market
state.UNRESOLVED: a route is inactive unless its fully matured 90-day shadow outcomes have positive mean and at least fifty-percent directional accuracy

scenario.confirmation: the next completed one-hour bar moves in the selected route direction with directional body and taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: outside the prior 24-hour extreme plus twenty-five percent of prior hourly ATR
scenario.management: trail the best completed hourly close by one and a half prior hourly ATRs
scenario.exit: trailing stop or before the next UTC daily boundary
scenario.arbitration: one active route, one focal market and one global position

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: daily state uses completed returns; route activation uses only shadow trades whose exit is strictly earlier than the new decision; entry follows a separate completed hour

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Freeze the shadow activation and selected daily route unchanged, then implement in one NautilusTrader account.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune dispersion, activation, confirmation or stop parameters after evaluation.
